blocks.content: In this chapter, we will learn what Omega notation means mathematically.
The Omega notation represents the lower bound of the running time of an algorithm.
Let's understand the meaning of the statement with the help of a graph first.
Here, the function f(n) is represented on the graph.
Next, on the same graph, we will plot another function c * g(n), that will intersect f(n) at the n0n_0n0​ point.

items: the function f(n) will always be equal to or above the function c * g(n) after the n0n_0n0​ point

blocks.content: In this case, c * g(n) is called the lower bound of f(n) because the c * g(n)) function will never grow faster than f(n).
